resources.string: Lets Guardian Angel see which app is in front so she can lock apps you chose to restrict. It reads the app\'s name. With Lock guard on it looks for her name on Settings screens, and with She peeks on it takes a screenshot about every 5 minutes, kept privately in the app. With Porn block on it checks the screen of browsers, social apps and any apps you add every few seconds on the phone, saves nothing, and notices when you open an app on your adult apps list. It also draws her mark if you switch it on. Turn this off at any time to stop her.
